description: This file contains automation scripts for purchase workflows in an ERP system, including creating material requests, RFQs, supplier quotations, purchase orders, and subcontracting processes.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Main function orchestrating purchase workflows including RFQ creation, supplier quotations, purchase orders, and subcontracting.

methods.name: make_material_request
methods.description: Creates and submits a material request for a given item code and quantity.

methods.name: add_suppliers
methods.description: Adds random suppliers to a given RFQ.

methods.name: make_subcontract
methods.description: Creates a subcontract purchase order and associated stock entry for a sub-contracted item.

methods.name: get_rm_item
methods.description: Prepares a stock transfer item for a subcontracted item.
